name: Rikujobu ☆ Zukobako Natsu Gasshuku
original_name: りくじょぶ☆ズコバコ夏合宿
source:
You are the PE teacher and current adviser to the Track & Field club.
In preparation for the Autumn tournament, you propose to hold a 'Training Camp'.
While some of the members were treating it as a holiday, or didn't want to go...
Everyone ended up joining and the first day of training ended without incident.
... or at least it was supposed to!

Entering the bath, you are pushed down by a busty girl for some soapy titty job play.
When you try to go to sleep, you are the victim of a night prowling girl.
During practice, you end up forced into having outdoor sex... AND MORE!?

These girls were supposed to be graceful flowers, innocent and inexperience maidens...
But, it would seem not to be the case, as they all tempt you with their honey pots.
Just what happened to them? Confused, you are unable to resist their advances
and are used as an object for SEXXXXX... (Not that you are complaining or anything.)

Can you return in one piece from this 3 nights, 4 days 'training camp' of...... cumbliss?
